verdicts.title: Bounds for the Zeros of Quaternionic Polynomials and Regular Functions Using Matrix Techniques
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We investigate the problem of determining the zeros of quaternionic polynomials using matrix method. In a recent paper, Dar et al. \cite{RD} proved that the zeros of a quaternionic polynomial and the left eigenvalues of the corresponding companion matrix are identical.
